name: Lola Beerendonk
bio: I started my PhD at the Department of Psychology of the University of Amsterdam in January 2018. In my NWO funded PhD project, I investigated the influence of cortical state and neuromodulation on conscious perception. I combined EEG, pupillometry, behavioral manipulations, and pharmacological interventions to elucidate the influence of fluctuations in endogenous activity on consciousness.
